newsitem.title: USA: Anesta's Actiq to get FDA review in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Anesta's Actiq to get FDA review in Sept.

text.p: Anesta Corp said Monday that its new drug application for Actiq (oral transmucosal fentanyl citrate) has been scheduled for review by the US Food and Drug Administration on September 17.
Anesta said an appliction seeking approval to market Actiq for chronic pain was submitted on November 13, 1996. Abbott Laboratories Inc is Anesta's US marketing and manufacturing partner for Actiq.

The Actiq dosage unit, it added, is made up of a drug matrix attached to a handle which eases the oral absorption of the drug fentanyl, enabling patients to obtain pain relief and individually control the drug's delivery non-invasively.
